comment: Server-only env vars for the bundle-secret gate (SECURITY.md / app-spec §7): the gate builds with a sentinel value in each of these and fails if any sentinel reaches build/client. Includes vars documented but not yet consumed, so the gate is already standing when they land. test/client-config.test.ts asserts every uncommented .env.example key is classified either here or as client-safe. WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID moved to clientSafeEnv in PR 5.1 (§7 allowlist amendment: a WC project id is public by design — it rides in every pairing URI). M6.3 (§7 allowlist amendment): WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY is client-safe (a VAPID public key ships in pushManager.subscribe); WEB_PUSH_VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and WEB_PUSH_VAPID_SUBJECT stay server-only. SESSION_SECRET was retired in PR 5.1: sessions are opaque random ids over a server-side row; nothing to sign.
